power-alpha-beta.alt: Two normal curves for the sample proportion from samples of 200. The left curve, centered at the null value 0.50, is the distribution if the null is true; the right curve, centered at 0.60, is the distribution if the true proportion is 0.60. A vertical line at the cutoff 0.558 marks where the test rejects H0 at alpha = 0.05 (sample proportions above it). Under the null curve, the small area beyond the cutoff is alpha, the probability of a Type I error. Under the alternative curve, the area to the left of the cutoff is beta, the probability of a Type II error, about 0.11; the area to the right is the power, about 0.89.
